acceptance_criteria.criterion: The Step constructor calls array_merge($this->getDefaultData(), $data) and assigns the result to $this->data.
The dead-code if(!isset($this->data)) block (including the $this->setComplete(false) call) is removed.
On first visit without preselection (empty $data), the step receives only its defaults from getDefaultData().
On first visit with preselection ($data has some keys), defaults fill gaps for unset keys and preselection values win for overlapping keys.
On subsequent visits (full saved step data), behavior is effectively unchanged since saved data already contains all keys.
Steps that return an empty array from getDefaultData() are completely unaffected (array_merge(array(), $data) === $data).
All existing wizard tests continue to pass without modification.
